mandate: C391 XSKEW3 — test the cross-sectional intraday lag-1 cross third-moment time-irreversibility gap (XSKEW3) x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. XSKEW3 scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 returns ending at close bar t, X=r[t-W+1..t] (W returns): c3_a=mean_i(x_i*x_{i-1}**2) (lag-1 cross third moment, orientation A); c3_b=mean_i(x_i**2*x_{i-1}) (orientation B); rv=sum_i(x_i**2) (realized variance, normalizer); xskew3_gap=(c3_a-c3_b)/max(rv,eps); xskew3_raw=c3_a-c3_b; eps=1e-12. The third-moment gap is zero in expectation for a time-reversible process; a persistent non-zero gap is directional time-irreversibility. NaN if t<W, any non-finite return in X, rv<=eps, or non-finite output. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (xskew3_gap_dev, xskew3_raw_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs/denominator requirements (t<W=256).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 returns ending at close bar t, X=r[t-W+1..t] (W returns): c3_a=mean(x_i*x_{i-1}**2); c3_b=mean(x_i**2*x_{i-1}); rv=sum(x_i**2); xskew3_gap=(c3_a-c3_b)/max(rv,eps); xskew3_raw=c3_a-c3_b.
methodology.signals: xskew3_gap/xskew3_raw over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.xskew3_vectorization_note: XSKEW3 via sliding_window_view(returns, 256)[1:] over the per-asset return series aligned to close bars t>=W; c3_a=(rows[:,1:]*rows[:,:-1]**2).mean(axis=1), c3_b=(rows[:,1:]**2*rows[:,:-1]).mean(axis=1), rv=(rows*rows).sum(axis=1); window-NaN enforced by finite-count over the W-bar trailing returns. No Python loop over bars x assets — validated against brute force with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
